في سابقة في السوق الجزائرية: A first in the Algerian market
Ooredoo الجزائر تُخفض الحد الأدنى لخدمة: Ooredoo Algeria lowers the minimum threshold for the Storm service to 5 DZD
مواصلةً لجهودها الرامية إلى جعل خدماتها: Continuing its efforts to make its services more accessible, available, and suited to the daily needs of its customers, Ooredoo Algeria announces the adoption of a new minimum threshold for the Storm service. Customers can now top up their Storm balance starting from just 5 DZD at points of sale and Ooredoo spaces, in a move that is the first of its kind in the Algerian market.
تُتيح هذه الخطوة الجديدة للزبائن الاستفا: This new step allows customers to benefit from a more flexible minimum threshold, depending on the top-up method. The minimum threshold for the Storm service has been lowered to 5 DZD at Ooredoo points of sale and spaces, while it has been set at 10 DZD for top-ups via the BaridiMob app. As for digital top-ups via E-Storm, available using EDAHABIA and CIB electronic payment cards, the minimum threshold remains unchanged at 100 DZD.
من خلال خفض الحد الأدنى لخدمة Storm إلى: By lowering the minimum threshold for the Storm service to 5 DZD, Ooredoo offers its customers greater flexibility, ease, and freedom of choice in utilizing its services. From now on, every customer can complete their balance top-up with the exact amount they actually have available and that suits their needs, without being constrained by a high minimum amount.
تندرج هذه المبادرة في إطار استراتيجية Oo: This initiative is part of Ooredoo's strategy to place the customer experience, ease of service access, and proximity at the core of its services, in line with their daily needs and aspirations.
مع إتاحة خدمة Storm ابتداءً من 5 دج على: By making the Storm service available starting from 5 DZD at points of sale and Ooredoo spaces, Ooredoo Algeria takes a new step in enhancing the accessibility of its services, and reaffirms its commitment to providing simpler, more flexible solutions tailored to its customers' needs.
